definitions.gloss: pedestrian traffic; people coming and going
definitions.explanation: The number of people passing along a street or through a place.

examples.japanese: {人通|ひとどお}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are a lot of people around.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{人通|ひとどお}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}なく→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: At night there are fewer people on the street.

examples.japanese: {人通|ひとどお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{避|さ}けて→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧、⟦{明|あか}るい→明るい：00616_akarui⟧⟦{大通|おおどお}り→大通り：26913_oodoori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}って→通る：01243_tooru⟧⟦{帰|かえ}り→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: Avoid quiet streets and come home along the bright main road.

notes:
Describes how busy a street is with people on foot; cars are ⟦{交通量|こうつうりょう}→交通量：17876_koutsuuryou⟧.

- {人通|ひとどお}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧ / ⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧: busy / quiet (of a street)
- {人通|ひとどお}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{絶|た}える→絶える：13814_taeru⟧: the streets empty
- {人通|ひとどお}り⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: a busy place
